name: enactus-vips-tc-ims
description: Enactus VIPS-TC Inventory & Sales Management System (Tahsin & Upcycle)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.setup:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run db:push && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
